def score(f, p, hw, w):
    s = np.log2(1.0 + f.edge_waste) * w[0]
    s = s + f.has_spill * w[1]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.spill_traffic_ratio) * w[2]
    s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[3]
    tl = -np.log2(np.maximum(1e-6, 1.0 - f.tail_waste))
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        s = s + np.log2(f.operand_tile_traffic_ratio) * w[4]
        s = s + f.tile_roofline_deficit * w[5]
        s = s + tl * w[6]
        s = s + f.wave_count_deficit * w[7]
        s = s + f.serial_reduction_dependency * w[8]
        s = s + f.parallel_reduction_traffic_fraction * w[9]
    else:
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.instruction_density) * w[10]
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[11]
        s = s + f.resident_block_scarcity * w[12]
        s = s + np.log2(f.operand_tile_traffic_ratio) * w[13]
        s = s + tl * w[14]
        s = s + f.wave_count_deficit * w[15]
        s = s + f.serial_reduction_dependency * w[16]
        s = s + f.parallel_reduction_traffic_fraction * w[17]
    return s
